limitations: planar reduced-order model only; steering/yaw is not dynamically solved
no-slip rolling is assumed while a friction-margin diagnostic detects when that assumption becomes invalid
motor torque-speed values come from current project placeholders until measured/datasheet-bound
contact compliance, shell deformation, backlash, tire/grip hysteresis, battery sag and thermal behavior are not high-fidelity modeled
results are screening evidence and never physical acceptance
